gradingSystem.label: AEGRYN — Grading System
gradingSystem.title:
AEGRYN
Grading System.
gradingSystem.intro: Das AEGRYN Grade-Protokoll ist der Zertifizierungsstandard für digitale Tech-Assets in Europa. Inspiriert von Schweizer Uhrmacher-Bewertungsstandards und auf den SaaS-M&A-Markt zugeschnitten, liefert es ein reproduzierbares, nachvollziehbares und unabhängiges Rating.
gradingSystem.cifsDesc: Jedes Asset wird anhand von vier unabhängigen Dimensionen bewertet, jede mit 0 bis 25 Punkten. Die Gesamtpunktzahl von 100 bestimmt das Grade.

cifs.name: Code
cifs.desc: Quellcodequalität, Testabdeckung, technische Schulden, Dokumentation, Implementierungssicherheit und skalierbare Architektur.

cifs.name: IP
cifs.desc: Geistiges Eigentum, Markteintrittsbarrieren, eingetragene Marken, Patente und nachhaltige Differenzierung.

cifs.name: Finance
cifs.desc: Wichtige Finanzkennzahlen: ARR, MRR, Churn, LTV/CAC, Burn Rate, Runway und Wachstumshistorie. Alle Daten werden gegen Quelldokumente geprüft.

cifs.name: Security
cifs.desc: DSGVO- und Schweizer DSG-Konformität, Infrastruktursicherheit, Zugriffsmanagement und Datenschutz-Governance.
criteria: Verschlüsselung von Daten im Ruhezustand und bei der Übertragung

gradingSystem.gradesDesc: Jedes Grade entspricht einem genauen Punktebereich und einem definierten Asset-Profil. AEG ★ und AAA werden weniger als 15% der eingereichten Assets verliehen.

grades.label: Stellar
grades.profile: Außergewöhnliches Asset. Referenzarchitektur, starkes IP, Top-Dezil-Finanzkennzahlen. Für institutionelle Transaktionen geeignet.

grades.profile: Hochwertiges Asset mit soliden Grundlagen in allen vier Dimensionen.

grades.label: Standard
grades.profile: Gutes Asset mit identifizierten Stärken und dokumentierten Verbesserungsbereichen.
grades.typical: Wachsendes SaaS, einige Lücken in Tests oder Compliance.

grades.label: Developing
grades.profile: Asset in Entwicklung mit identifizierbarem Potenzial, aber strukturellen Schwächen.
grades.typical: Produkt in früher Traktion, erhebliche technische Schulden.

grades.label: Early Stage
grades.profile: Early-Stage-Asset mit teilweisen Grundlagen. Zertifizierung mit detailliertem Remediierungsbericht.

process.title: Einreichung & Vorqualifikation
process.desc: Empfang der Unterlagen, Prüfung der Vollständigkeit (Data Room, Finanzdaten, Codebase-Zugang). Vorqualifikation innerhalb von 5 Werktagen.

process.desc: Code-Review durch zwei AEGRYN-zertifizierte Senior-Ingenieure. Automatisierter Sicherheitsscan gefolgt von manueller Überprüfung. Dauer: 5–10 Tage.

process.title: Kommerzielle Analyse (IP + Finance)

meta.title: FAQ — Frequently Asked Questions — AEGRYN
meta.desc: Answers to frequently asked questions about AEGRYN Grade certification, transactions, sessions and accounts.

items.q: What is the AEGRYN Grade?
items.a: The AEGRYN Grade is an official multi-dimensional certification evaluating 4 dimensions: Code (C), IP & Rights (I), Finance (F), Security (S). Each dimension is scored out of 25. The total score (out of 100) determines the official Grade: ★ Exceptional (≥90), AAA Excellent (≥75), AA Very Good (≥60), A Good (≥45), B Correct (≥30).

items.q: What is the difference between an official Grade and an estimated grade?
items.a: An official Grade is assigned after a real audit by AEGRYN analysts, co-signed by independent external partners (law firm, accountant, cybersecurity partner) who engage their professional liability. It can be published in the catalogue. An estimated grade (from /valuation or AEGRYN Review) is an indicative opinion based on declared data, always suffixed "(estimated)" with no contractual value.

items.q: How long does the certification process take?
items.a: AEGRYN Review: 5 working days after confirmed payment. AEGRYN Review+: 10 working days. Full Auction Certification: 3 to 5 weeks depending on asset complexity.

items.q: How much does certification cost?
items.a: AEGRYN Review: €2,000 excl. VAT — deductible if full certification started within 6 months. AEGRYN Review+: €5,000 excl. VAT — same conditions. Auction Certification: free if transaction (AEGRYN earns commission on sale). Precise conditions in signed mandate.

items.q: My asset was declined. Can I resubmit?
items.a: Yes. Each refusal is accompanied by a detailed written report identifying areas for improvement. Our Advisory service can support you through remediation. A declined asset may be resubmitted at any time if documented improvements have been made.

items.q: What is KRYV Protocol?
items.a: KRYV Protocol is our blockchain certification infrastructure component. It generates a cryptographic fingerprint of the codebase at the exact date of certification and/or transfer, recorded immutably. This allows any buyer to prove at any future date that the code received matches exactly the certified code.

items.q: What types of assets can I submit?
items.a: AEGRYN certifies and transacts digital tech assets: B2B SaaS, mobile apps, marketplaces, AI protocols, digital intellectual property. Minimum ticket: €500,000 estimated valuation.

items.q: Will my identity be disclosed to buyers?
items.a: No. AEGRYN maintains the confidentiality of your identity throughout the process. It is only disclosed to the buyer after both parties' explicit agreement and AEGRYN's introduction decision.

items.q: How long does the exclusive mandate last?
items.a: 60 days, renewable by mutual agreement. After this period without a closed transaction, you regain full contractual freedom.

items.q: How do I become a member buyer?
items.a: Via the application form at /auction#membership. Your application is reviewed by AEGRYN within 10 working days. A 20–30 minute qualification interview is required. Financial capacity documents are necessary.

items.q: What is the minimum acquisition ticket?
What bid models are available?
items.a: AEGRYN offers 4 bid models: Club Deal (individual + up to 4 co-investors), Corporate (legal entity or JV), Fund (PE/VC/Family Office, IC timeline possible), Equity Stake (equity participation without full transfer). See /auction/bid-models for full details.

items.q: How does the escrow work?
items.a: After a signed Heads of Agreement, the buyer deposits 10% of the agreed price with a third-party partner bank. AEGRYN never holds these funds. See /terms/cgv for withdrawal rules.

items.q: What KYC documents are required?
items.a: Individuals: valid ID + proof of address (<3 months) + proof of financial capacity. Entities (companies, funds): company registration equivalent (<3 months) + articles of association + representative's ID + UBO declaration (≥25%) + regulatory licence if applicable.

items.q: What is the data room?
items.a: The data room is a secure space containing the asset's complete documents (grade report, audited financials, IP contracts, technical documentation). Accessible only to member buyers who have signed the asset-specific NDA. Every consultation is timestamped and logged.

items.q: When and how are session results published?
items.a: Results are published on /auction/results within 30 days of each session closing, in anonymised form: grade, category, sector, valuation range (±20%), process duration. No identities are disclosed.

items.q: What is an AEGRYN Session?
items.a: AEGRYN Sessions are private transaction events held twice a year in Switzerland. 6 to 10 Grade A or above certified assets are presented to a closed circle of qualified member buyers. Access is by invitation only.

items.q: I forgot my password.
items.a: Use the "Forgot password" link on /client/login. A reset email will be sent within 5 minutes.

items.q: How do I update my KYC information?
items.a: Via the "My Profile" section of your client space. Updated documents are submitted to AEGRYN for re-validation.
